name: Regulation of metanephric kidney development and size
rationale: All three members regulate kidney/metanephros development or size, unlike confusables centred on nephron epithelial differentiation, renal proliferation or nephric duct/ureter formation.

name: Iminoglycinuria from proline and glycine transporter defects
rationale: All members are SLC36A2/SLC6A20 defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria, whereas confusables cover Hartnup disorder, cystinuria, general amino acid transport or sugar/urate transport.

qualifier: positive and negative regulation, coronavirus modulation
name: Regulation of RIG-I-like receptor signaling, including coronavirus modulation
rationale: Members cover cytosolic dsRNA sensing by RIG-I/MDA5 and its downstream TRAF3/TRAF6 IRF and NF-kB arms with both positive and negative regulation and SARS-CoV modulation, while confusables add IRF3/IRF7-driven type I IFN induction, OAS or RSV evasion and lack the SARS-CoV or negative-regulation members.

qualifier: adenine nucleotide interconversion and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
name: Nucleoside transport and adenine nucleotide interconversion
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane and mitochondrial transport of nucleosides, nucleobases, nucleoside-analogue drugs and ADP/ATP plus adenine nucleotide interconversion, distinguishing it from confusables focused on de novo/salvage nucleotide synthesis, PRPP and creatine metabolism.

name: MHC class II antigen presentation with monocyte expression signatures
rationale: All members concern MHC class II peptide processing and presentation, and the theme carries the monocyte (IV) and antigen-presentation (I/II) modules that confusables lack, while confusables add regulation of presentation, lipid/MHC Ib presentation or surface signatures.

name: RUNX1 transcriptional regulation of blood-cell lineage genes
rationale: Members are RUNX1 regulation and its RUNX-family partners controlling myeloid, megakaryocyte, interleukin and BCR genes, whereas confusables extend to non-hematopoietic RUNX1 targets (estrogen receptor, WNT, keratinocytes), AP-2 factors, granulopoiesis or megakaryocyte development.

core: Glycogen metabolism and dietary hexose uptake
qualifier: glycogen storage diseases and intestinal hexose absorption
name: Glycogen metabolism and intestinal hexose digestion and transport
rationale: Members span glycogen synthesis/breakdown and its storage diseases plus carbohydrate digestion and hexose transport, combining what the confusables split into hexose/urate transport, galactose catabolism or glycolysis/gluconeogenesis.

qualifier: telomerase RNA trafficking to Cajal bodies
name: Telomere maintenance, including telomerase trafficking to Cajal bodies
rationale: Members cover telomere replication, capping, recombination-based lengthening and telomerase assembly, and uniquely include Cajal body localization of telomerase RNA/scaRNA, whereas confusables are general DNA repair, senescence or chromatin remodeling.

core: Inflammatory cytokine production from innate sensors
qualifier: TLR2/4 bacterial lipid sensing and NLRP inflammasome IL-1 processing
name: TLR2/4 lipopolysaccharide sensing and NLRP inflammasome IL-1 production
rationale: Members combine LPS/lipopeptide detection through TLR2/4/5-MyD88-IRAK4 with NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and their control of inflammatory cytokines, whereas confusables lack the inflammasome arm, lack TLR2/LPS detection, or centre on pyroptosis and non-NLRP inflammasomes.

core: Fc receptor and B cell receptor signaling regulation
qualifier: inhibitory receptors such as SIRP family and inhibitory Fc receptor
name: Inhibitory receptor restraint of Fc receptor and BCR signaling
rationale: Members concern immunoreceptor tuning by inhibitory Fc receptor and SIRP-family signaling that dampens BCR signaling, phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, whereas confusables cover activating FCGR/BCR signaling, ADCC and hypersensitivity.

name: Fas/TRAIL death-receptor apoptosis in T-cell immunity
rationale: Members describe Fas/TRAIL-induced caspase-8 activation, c-FLIP and BID, with T-cell activation-induced death, allograft rejection and anti-tumor defense, while confusables shift toward necroptosis, TNFR1 signaling and hepatocyte survival.

core: Myeloid and antigen-presenting cell expression signatures
name: Monocyte, dendritic cell and myeloid activation expression signatures
rationale: Members are leukocyte expression signatures dominated by monocytes, dendritic cells and neutrophils, and the theme adds monocyte activation and PU.1-driven myeloid identity modules that confusables lack.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and receptor signaling
name: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt/calcium signaling
rationale: Members cover PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis/secretion, FZD/LRP5 receptor regulation and WNT5A/calcium non-canonical signaling, whereas confusables centre on canonical DVL/AXIN/beta-catenin signaling or Hedgehog.

name: Protein stability control by ubiquitination and chaperonin folding
rationale: Members regulate protein stabilization/destabilization, K48 and auto-ubiquitination and proteasomal catabolism, and the theme adds TRiC/CCT chaperonin folding that the confusables (deubiquitinases, RHOBTB cycles, stress granules) lack.

name: Nuclear mRNA export and snRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members concern nuclear-pore export of mature mRNAs and snRNAs with cap hypermethylation and snRNP assembly, separating the theme from confusables on 3'-end/histone pre-mRNA processing, splicing or tRNA/ribosome export.

name: TRP channel-mediated thermal, mechanical and acid nociception
rationale: Members are detection of thermal, mechanical and acidic noxious stimuli and pain behavior carried by TRP channels, whereas confusables involve itch/fever or two-pore potassium channels.

name: Gluconeogenesis, fructose metabolism and glucose-6-phosphate handling
rationale: Members cover gluconeogenesis and its alanine/oxaloacetate inputs, fructose catabolism and its disorders, glucose-6-phosphatase/transporter defects and glucokinase regulation, whereas confusables emphasise glycolysis, glycerol/alditol metabolism or glycogen synthesis.

name: Sulfur amino acid and histidine catabolism
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, cysteine catabolism, sulfide oxidation and molybdenum-cofactor-dependent sulfite handling, and add histidine catabolism that confusables (vitamin B6, selenium, phenylalanine) lack.

core: Golgi glycosylation of signaling proteins and proteoglycans
name: Notch O-glycosylation and heparan sulfate biosynthesis
rationale: Members are O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR proteins plus heparan sulfate (EXT1/EXT2) synthesis, distinguishing the theme from confusables with Wnt secretion, somitogenesis or chondroitin/dermatan sulfate synthesis.

name: Extracellular matrix maturation with ascorbate supply and hyaluronan degradation
rationale: Members concern oxidative collagen crosslinking, basement membrane assembly, ascorbate/dehydroascorbate supply and hyaluronan degradation, whereas confusables cover collagen synthesis, elastic fibres or vitamin C/E responses without hyaluronan breakdown.

name: Misfolded protein quality control via ERAD and organelle-selective autophagy
rationale: Members cover responses to misfolded proteins, ERAD regulation, E3 ubiquitination and selective autophagy of ER, peroxisomes, nucleus and late endosomes, whereas confusables emphasise aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy or proteolysis regulation.

name: MHC class II antigen presentation and its regulation
rationale: All members concern MHC class II peptide processing and presentation, and the theme adds positive/negative regulation of antigen processing that confusables lack, while confusables add cross-presentation, monocyte modules or lipid/MHC Ib presentation.

name: Mevalonate pathway and cholesterol biosynthesis
rationale: Members run from isopentenyl, farnesyl and geranylgeranyl diphosphate through lanosterol to cholesterol via Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell routes, whereas confusables are fatty acid elongation, dolichol synthesis or bile acid synthesis.

qualifier: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and coenzyme A supply
name: TCA cycle, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and coenzyme A supply
rationale: Members span TCA cycle intermediates and PDH/OGDH/OADH complexes with their lipoylation and DLD, plus CoA biosynthesis, whereas confusables add ATP synthesis, Fe-S cluster assembly or glycine/lysine catabolism.

name: Inhibition of VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members negatively regulate VEGF signaling and endothelial proliferation, migration and tube formation during sprouting, whereas confusables are positive regulators or endothelial activation and apoptosis.
